name: @absolutejs/artifacts
description: Typed, versioned artifacts for AI products — schemas, lifecycle, storage, rendering, publishing, revisions, and agent tools without prescribing a database or host.
author: Alex Kahn

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build src/index.ts src/manifest.ts --outdir dist --root ./src --target=bun --external @sinclair/typebox --external @sinclair/typebox/value && tsc --emitDeclarationOnly --project tsconfig.json && absolute-manifest emit
scripts.release: bun run format && bun run test && bun run build && bun publish
